answer_1.quote: We use generative DST models that generate the values of slots, as they are flexible and require minimal annotation... We also train a CoQR model (CoQR-R) on CANARD dataset to rewrite user utterances to be self‑contained.
answer_1.outputs: generated dialog states and rewritten user utterances

answer_2.quote: The most widely used metric for DST is Joint Goal Accuracy (JGA)... we use Relative Slot Accuracy (RSA)... We propose a new metric CDTA (Cross-domain Turn Accuracy) to measure a model's ability to capture the cross‑domain value transfer behavior.
